FN-QCAK44-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 45
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/21/2023
REVISED
Senate Bill 45 as introduced increases the salary amount paid to members of a county board of
registrars for each day's attendance on board business from $80 per day to $100 per day, which
will increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an estimated maximum of $806,000
for the increased salary expenses.
In addition, this bill could increase the obligations of the county general funds by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the number of county board of registrar members electing
to participate in any county provided health insurance program.
